title: PAL-V, Inter-Data and FLYVE join forces to create FlyDrive ecosystem in Sweden
summary: Such an ecosystem would bring together operators, training organizations, maintenance capabilities, public authorities and commercial partners.
body_markdown:
PAL-V, the FlyDrive mobility company, has signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with Inter-Data Science Port Hagfors AB, and FLYVE, developer of FlyDrive ecosystems for professionals and governmental operators, to jointly realize a FlyDrive Ecosystem in Sweden.


**Building a FlyDrive Ecosystem**


The partners share the ambition of exploring a complete FlyDrive ecosystem to enhance mobility, logistics and operations capabilities, locally, regionally and in Sweden.


Such an ecosystem would bring together operators, training organizations, maintenance capabilities, public authorities and commercial partners to support the safe and effective integration of FlyDrive capabilities into daily operations.


Carlo Maasbommel, director of FLYVE, states: “The future of mobility, logistics and operations requires more than advanced platforms. It requires a complete ecosystem in which operators can train, collaborate and develop. Sweden offers a unique combination of infrastructure, expertise and ambition. Together with PAL-V and Inter-Data, FLYVE looks forward to exploring how the region can benefit from FlyDrive operations in Hagfors and Sweden at large.”


PAL-V Photo


**Positive Local Support**


The developments have been positively received by Hagfors Municipality and Hagfors Airport. Both recognize the opportunities FlyDrive mobility could bring to the region, such as international cooperation, economic and knowledge development and new employment opportunities.


Their positive attitude provides an encouraging foundation for further exploration and dialogue with regional stakeholders.


The initial phase will focus on feasibility studies, identifying regional opportunities and engaging relevant public and private stakeholders. The ambition is to establish close cooperation with regional and national organizations in Sweden.


Jan van Bremen, director of Inter-Data Science Port Hagfors AB, welcomed the MoU and highlighted its potential impact on the region: “Inter-Data Science Port Hagfors was established to attract innovative industries and create new opportunities for the region. FlyDrive mobility represents a highly promising new sector that combines advanced technology, skills development and inter- and multi-disciplinary collaboration. We are excited to explore how this partnership can contribute to long-term economic growth.”


**Strengthening Europe’s Leadership in FlyDrive Mobility**


The future of mobility is not just about getting from A to B. It is about reaching more places, responding faster and making a difference when it matters most.


Whether supporting emergency services, infrastructure inspections, regional connectivity or business travel, FlyDrive capabilities has the potential to help organizations overcome traditional limitations in accessibility and other scarce resources.


Robert Dingemanse, founder and CEO of PAL-V, believes strong regional partnerships are essential to unlocking that potential: “For FlyDrive mobility to realize its full potential, it must be supported by strong regional ecosystems that bring together training, operations, maintenance and innovation. Sweden’s commitment to technology, education and regional development makes it an attractive location to explore. Through this collaboration with Inter-Data and FLYVE, we aim to assess how the region could benefit from FlyDrive mobility in Sweden and contribute to Europe’s leadership in this emerging sector.”


Collaborations such as this demonstrate how innovative partnerships can help unlock new possibilities for mobility, economic development and regional connectivity, while creating practical solutions for professionals, organizations and governments alike.


Alongside Sweden, PAL-V is exploring opportunities for additional FlyDrive Mobility Centers in Germany and Italy, reinforcing Europe’s position as a global leader in FlyDrive mobility solutions.


*This press release was prepared and distributed by PAL-V.*
